{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Attention, Imperial lawbreakers! You are in violation of Statute 1983 of the Sullustan Criminal Code. Drop your weapons and surrender the gem!|Miel Muwn|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
Statute 52974 of the Code classified the act of impersonating a peace [[Officer/Legends|officer]] as a severe offense. Other statutes included Statute 1983, which Officer [[Miel Muwn]] quoted while attempting to arrest [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kasstroff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] for purchasing the stolen [[Murustavan Ruby]], and Statute 87365.
